objects.text:
Pre-visit notes from the client (WhatsApp) - KRA GF / FF M&E layouts marked up by hand

Sitting Room
  1-5 = in-wall speakers
  1-3 = WS180 (1 R, 2 C below TV, 3 L)
  4 + 5 = W165 (Rear R, Rear L)
  * = C180 Atmos ceiling speakers (x2, in the slatted ceiling)
  Subwoofer can go anywhere, dependent on furniture placement

Other rooms
  Circle-cross = suggested speaker placement (ceiling) - Gym, Lounge, Entrance Hall, Playroom,
  Breakfast, Dining, Living; FF Master Bed, Master Dressing (2 choices of placement), Beds 2-5
  Bed 3: 'just next to light'

Existing on site
  Monitor Audio W165 in-wall (boxed), in-ceiling LCR already in the slatted ceiling above the TV wall
